description: This Java class defines the 'RetrieveFeature' command within the Eclipse Ditto framework, used to retrieve a specific feature from a thing by its ID. It includes constructors, factory methods, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for feature-related properties.

classes.name: RetrieveFeature
classes.description: A command class used to retrieve a specific feature from a thing, identified by feature ID, possibly with selected fields, in the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a RetrieveFeature command instance with ThingId, featureId, optional selected fields, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a RetrieveFeature instance from a JSON string or object, deserializing the command.

methods.name: getSelectedFields
methods.description: Returns the optional selected fields for the JSON representation of the feature.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path representing the resource location.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends command data to a JSON object builder, respecting schema version and predicate filter.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated ditto headers.
